description: Routing case (e) — mixed in-domain + web query. The orchestrator's prompt explicitly tells it to handle the in-domain part first when a question carries both. Asserts first_handoff_must_be == Buildium Agent regardless of whether the conversation later involves web context. The Agents SDK keeps the conversation with the first specialist after a handoff, so this case mainly exercises 'orchestrator picks Buildium first, not Web first'.

input.user_message: Look up the tenant in unit 4B then check typical plumbing rates in their zip code.
